scenarios.scenario: Insight — Determine which projects are in the solution vs referenced
scenarios.reasoning: Strong, evidence-backed analysis that answers all three parts of the question and correctly pinpoints the root cause (LrgWindowsAppManifest not in the solution, only evaluated via restore/GetNativeManifest, so its output dir is never populated). Investigation was mostly efficient with clean recovery from two dead-end shell calls. Deductions for a project-count inconsistency (says 18 src, lists 20; '42' unverified against the list) and for confidently asserting no Debug/Release divergence after only partially reading the metaproj — the Debug|x64 entries it saw were explained away rather than verified, which is the one place the conclusion could be wrong.

rubricScores.criterion: Listed the projects that were built as part of the solution
Identified that LrgWindowsAppManifest was referenced but not included in the solution build
Noted the configuration (Debug vs Release) used for the missing project vs the referencing project
Connected the dots: project not in solution → wrong/stale output path
